title: Prior Halm says of Brother Osk, "a grief he didn't know was his own family's, not until you brought him this far east," but Osk himself had already said earlier, unprompted, "The water took my family in Fenmarch, before I ever wore this gray" — implying he already knew where and how they died.
where: The Priory of the Gray Church / Prior Halm dialogue
